12 recommended clinics where you can get VISIA skin diagnosis in Tokyo! Compare by price/area

"I would like to receive a VISIA diagnosis in Tokyo, but I don't know which clinic is right for me."

"I'm curious whether the quality of diagnosis changes between free and paid services, and whether it's okay to decline treatment."

Many people may have the same problems as mentioned above.

VISIA skin diagnosisis a skin image analysis system that allows you to check spots, wrinkles, texture, pores, UV spots, brown spots, redness, porphyrins, etc. in images and numerical values.

VISIA has been introduced in multiple areas in Tokyo, including Ginza, Omotesando, and Shinjuku.Prices and provision conditions range from 2,000 yen to around 10,000 yen.There is.

In this article, we will compare 12 clinics in Tokyo where you can receive skin imaging diagnosis by price and area. Centering on clinics that have introduced VISIA, clinics that have introduced NeoVoir I PLUS will also be listed with the model name clearly stated.

We will also show you how to check whether you can make a reservation based on diagnosis alone, and how to let them know if you do not want to sign a treatment contract on the spot.

When choosing a clinic,Fees, area, availability of diagnosis only, system for explaining resultsLet's check.

What you can learn from this article

  • How to choose a clinic for VISIA skin diagnosis in Tokyo (fees, area, diagnosis system, ease of refusal)
  • Comparison of characteristics of 12 recommended clinics in Tokyo that offer skin diagnosis

Yoshitomo Chihara

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity

  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

8 items that can be measured with VISIA skin diagnosis and how to read the skin condition

VISIA is a skin image analysis system that photographs the face using standard light, polarized light, UV light, etc., and allows you to check the skin surface and internal skin conditions with images and numerical values.

At the manufacturer Canfield Scientific, the main analysis items are8 items: stains, wrinkles, texture, pores, UV spots, brown stains, redness, and porphyrinWe are guiding you.

Contents of the 8 items and how to view the results
  • Check the 8 items that can be analyzed with VISIA
  • Percentile is a comparison index with people of the same age and skin type.
  • Visualize UV spots and porphyrins with special light

Check the 8 items that can be analyzed with VISIA

VISIA's typical analysis items are:Stains, wrinkles, texture, pores, UV spots, brown stains, redness, porphyrinThere are 8 items.

8 typical VISIA analysis items
  • stain: Spots with a different color/contrast from the surrounding skin color
  • wrinkles: Linear grooves and folds seen on the skin surface
  • Texture：Irregularities and smoothness of the skin surface
  • pores: circular opening on the skin surface
  • UV spot: Spots derived from melanin in the epidermis confirmed by UV photography
  • brown stain: Pigmentation and uneven color on the skin surface and subcutaneous area
  • redness: Red area related to inflammation and blood vessels, etc.
  • porphyrin: Metabolites derived from bacteria found in pores

Some clinics also provide supplementary indicators such as skin age based on VISIA analysis results. Display items and explanation methods vary depending on the model installed, the software, and the hospital's operation, so be sure to look at the screen when you receive the explanation.

Percentile is a comparison index with people of the same age and skin type.

VISIA has a function that compares the characteristics of the photographed skin with data of the same age and skin type.

Percentile is an indicator to see where your skin condition stands among comparison groups with the same attributes.Basically, the higher the percentile, the better the position relative to the comparison target.is.

VISIA's screen may also display other numbers, such as the number of features. Do not confuse percentile with number of features; ask your doctor or staff about the meaning of the displayed items.

Visualize UV spots and porphyrins with special light

VISIA uses UV photography to visualize UV spots and porphyrins that are difficult to understand with regular photographs.

UV spots are a material for understanding the effects of ultraviolet rays, and porphyrins are an indicator for confirming bacterial-derived metabolites present in pores.

VISIA is not the only company that can perform skin image diagnosis. There are other skin imaging diagnostic machines such as NeoVoir, so if you want VISIA, be sure to check the model name before making a reservation.

How to choose a clinic for VISIA skin diagnosis in Tokyo

When choosing a clinic in Tokyo to receive VISIA,Is it possible to undergo diagnosis only? Total amount including initial consultation fee, ease of access, and system for explaining results.It will be easier to compare if you check.

Four criteria for choosing a clinic
  • Check if you can make a reservation with VISIA alone
  • Compare total costs including initial consultation fee and counseling fee
  • Check the easy-to-reach area/distance from the station
  • Find out who will explain your results before booking

Check if you can make a reservation with VISIA alone

VISIA offer conditions vary by clinic. Some clinics allow you to make a reservation based on diagnosis alone, while others allow you to receive VISIA only if it is combined with counseling or treatment for targeted treatments.

For example, Marika Clinic Ginza officially announces that they do not accept reservations only through VISIA. On the other hand, Tokyo Ginza Medical Clinic and Fuji Nature Beauty Clinic Ginza list the prices for VISIA photography and counseling separately.

If you only want to check your skin condition, please ask before making your reservation, ``Can I make a reservation with just the VISIA photo shoot and explanation of the results?''

Compare total costs including initial consultation fee and counseling fee

In addition to VISIA's displayed price, check whether there is a separate initial consultation fee or counseling fee.

For example, MET BEAUTY CLINIC charges VISIA 3,630 yen plus an initial consultation fee of 2,420 yen, and Shinjuku Ekimae IGA Dermatology includes a VISIA skin diagnosis in the initial consultation fee of 4,400 yen. Toyocho Dermatology has a VISIA photo shoot + counseling fee of 2,200 yen and an initial consultation fee of 2,200 yen.

Prices are subject to change. When making a reservation, please check the ``total payment amount if you only receive VISIA on your first visit.''

Check the easy-to-reach area/distance from the station

The clinics we confirmed this time are located in Ginza, Omotesando, Shinjuku, Yoyogi, Azabu-Juban, Toyocho, etc.

If you plan to take VISIA multiple times to compare before and after treatment, it will be easier to continue if you choose a location that is easy to access from your home or work.

Find out who will explain your results before booking

The explanation system after VISIA photography differs depending on the hospital. Some clinics combine this with a doctor's examination, and some have staff members in charge of taking pictures and providing initial explanations.

If you would like to discuss the symptoms you are concerned about and the indications for treatment, it is best to ask at the time of making your reservation, ``Can I discuss the VISIA results with the doctor?'' and ``Will there be a separate consultation fee?''

12 recommended clinics in Tokyo where you can get a skin diagnosis

Based on official information as of September 18, 2026, we will introduce 12 clinics in Tokyo where you can receive skin image diagnosis.

The skin diagnostic machine that TCB and Kyoritsu Cosmetic Surgery have introduced is NeoVoir I PLUS, not VISIA. If you wish to use VISIA, please check the installed model before making a reservation.

Some clinics charge a separate initial consultation fee, some clinics offer free treatment as a set with the treatment, and some clinics do not allow you to make a separate reservation using VISIA. Please check not only the displayed price but also the terms and conditions.

TCB Tokyo Central Cosmetic Surgery supports skin diagnosis using NeoVoir I PLUS

At TCB Tokyo Central Cosmetic Surgery, we use a skin analysis machine made in Japan.NeoVoir I PLUSWe provide skin diagnosis using In Tokyo, Shinjuku Sanchome-in and Ikebukuro Ekimae-in are targeted hospitals, and skin conditions will be analyzed using NeoVoir I PLUS instead of VISIA.

NeoVoir I PLUS is a skin analyzer that photographs your face with an 18-megapixel high-resolution camera and allows you to check pores, wrinkles, age spots, pigmentation, redness, porphyrins, skin tone, skin irregularities, etc. in images and numerical values. Since it is possible to check skin conditions that are difficult to see with the naked eye, it can be used not only to address current skin concerns, but also to consider future beauty treatments and skin care.

Although it is not suitable for those who want to undergo VISIA itself, it is a candidate for those who want to check not only spots and pores, but also redness, sebum, unevenness on the skin surface, etc. from various angles. Based on the diagnosis results, you can receive beauty treatment and skin care suggestions tailored to your skin concerns, so it is easy to use even for those who are unsure of which treatment to choose.

The price of the skin diagnosis is not specified on the official skin diagnosis page. Please check the applicable hospitals and fees when making a reservation.

MY Beauty Clinic offers VISIA skin diagnosis in Ginza

MY Beauty Clinic is a beauty clinic located in Ginza.Skin diagnosis by VISIAWe offer VISIA uses high-performance cameras and image analysis technology to quantify and confirm skin conditions such as spots, wrinkles, pores, uneven color, and redness.

Furthermore, you can check hidden spots and porphyrins that are difficult to see with the naked eye, and it also supports comparisons with people of the same age and calculation of skin age. Even if you think you are concerned about age spots, you may actually have other skin concerns such as redness or pores, so this treatment is suitable for people who want to objectively understand their skin condition before choosing a treatment.

VISIA skin diagnosis is 3,300 yen (tax included)However, on the official website, it is announced that a VISIA skin diagnosis will be performed free of charge during the free consultation. This clinic is easy to compare for those who want to receive VISIA or those who want to consult about beauty treatments while looking at the diagnosis results.

The conditions and content of free application are subject to change. Please check the latest rates and conditions when booking.

Kyoritsu Cosmetic Surgery Shinjuku main hospital, dermatology department uses Japanese-made skin analysis machines.NeoVoir I PLUSWe conduct skin analysis using Although it is not VISIA, it is a system that analyzes the skin using images, then the doctor confirms the current skin condition and comes up with a treatment plan.

At Kyoritsu Cosmetic Surgery, we don't just look at skin problems, we emphasize "skin management" to maintain a healthy skin condition. Based on the results of your skin diagnosis, you can consult not only about beauty treatments, but also about daily skin care, cosmetic medications, injections, etc., so you can consider a wide range of options for your skin concerns.

On the official website,Free counseling with skin diagnostic machine using NeoVoir I PLUSI am guiding you. This is a good option for those who want to receive a skin analysis and doctor's explanation without spending a lot of money, but if you want to receive a skin diagnosis using VISIA, choose a clinic that uses VISIA.

The skin diagnostic machine at the Dermatology Department of Kyoritsu Cosmetic Surgery Shinjuku Main Clinic is NeoVoir I PLUS, not VISIA.

Tokyo Ginza Medical Clinic offers VISIA skin diagnosis in Ginza 1-chome/Kyobashi

At Tokyo Ginza Medical Clinic, we have skin imaging diagnostic equipment.VISIA EvolutionWe perform skin diagnosis using Color and UV photos are taken from the front, left and right of your face, and you can check spots, wrinkles, pores, uneven skin tone, etc. in images and numerical values.

It can display not only the number of spots and pores, but also scores and percentiles, allowing you to objectively check the condition of your skin, which is difficult to understand with just your senses. This allows you to see light spots and pigmentation that are difficult to see with the naked eye, as well as hidden spots that have not yet surfaced, which can be helpful when deciding on future treatment plans.

VISIA photography + counseling is 3,630 yen (tax included)It is. VISIA photography is free if you receive treatment on your first visit, so if you are considering cosmetic treatment after your skin diagnosis, be sure to check the terms and conditions.

The shooting time is approximately 5 to 10 minutes, and you will receive guidance regarding treatment based on the VISIA diagnosis results. Reasons why it is okay to refuse treatment after diagnosis and points on how to refuse

There is no need to sign a contract for aesthetic medical treatment just because you have received VISIA. After hearing the diagnosis results, you can compare costs and treatments before making a decision.

Points to avoid deciding on treatment on the spot
  • Consider diagnosis and treatment contract separately.
  • Tell them, ``I'll take it home today and consider it.''
  • Certain aesthetic medical contracts may be subject to cooling-off periods, etc.

Consider diagnosis and treatment contract separately.

VISIA is a device used for testing and counseling to understand skin conditions. Treatments may be proposed based on the diagnosis results, but receiving a proposal is not the same as signing a contract.

Check the cost, number of treatments, risks, cancellation conditions, etc., and if you are not satisfied, do not sign the contract on the day and take it home to consider it.

Tell them, ``I'll take it home today and consider it.''

If you don't want to make a decision on the spot, it is enough to say, ``I'll take it home today and consider it'' or ``I'll make a decision after listening to explanations from other hospitals.''

Frequently asked questions about VISIA skin diagnosis

5 frequently asked questions about VISIA skin diagnosis
  • Can men also undergo VISIA skin diagnosis?
  • Is it okay to just get a diagnosis and not undergo treatment?
  • Is a higher VISIA percentile better?
  • Is it okay to wear makeup before the diagnosis?
  • Can I take VISIA regularly?

Can men also undergo VISIA skin diagnosis?

There are no restrictions on the use of the VISIA device itself based on gender. However, clinics have different acceptance policies, so please check with each clinic to see if men can make reservations.

Is it okay to just get a diagnosis and not undergo treatment?

If the clinic accepts reservations for diagnosis only, there is no need to contract for treatment after VISIA photography.

However, some clinics, such as Marika Clinic Ginza, do not accept reservations only through VISIA. Please check the reservation conditions in advance.

Is a higher VISIA percentile better?

The "Comparison To Norms" percentile provided by the manufacturer indicates your position relative to a comparison group of people of the same age and skin type, and basically the higher it is, the better your position is.

On the other hand, the number of features such as spots and pores may be displayed separately on the screen, so check the names and meanings of the numbers before reading the results.

Is it okay to wear makeup before the diagnosis?

Make-up removal procedures vary depending on the clinic. Some clinics require you to wash your face before the photoshoot, so please check at the time of booking whether you can come in with your makeup on and whether cleansing facilities are available.

Can I take VISIA regularly?

Some clinics use VISIA to check progress before and after treatment and during the course. GRACY TOKYO CLINIC offers free progress photography during the course, and Tokyo Ginza Medical Clinic offers free VISIA photography at the first and final sessions of the beauty treatment course.

The interval between shots will vary depending on the treatment content and purpose, so consult with your doctor and staff to determine the interval.

Summary: Check the prices and terms of use and use VISIA skin diagnosis

VISIA is a device that analyzes images for spots, wrinkles, texture, pores, UV spots, brown spots, redness, porphyrin, etc., and objectively checks the skin condition.

In Tokyo, there are some hospitals where you can make a reservation just for VISIA photography, some hospitals that charge a set fee for the initial consultation, some hospitals that offer free treatment if you receive treatment, and some hospitals that do not accept reservations for VISIA only.

Before making a reservation, it will be easier to compare if you check the following three points: ``Total amount for the first visit,'' ``Can you make a reservation based on diagnosis only,'' and ``Who will be in charge of explaining the results?''

Prices and conditions of provision are subject to change, so please check each clinic's official website and reservation counter for the latest information.
